d: Bihar se lekar dilli ke ramlila maidan tak vipakshi 'indiya' (INDIA) gathbandhan ka bara shakti pradarshan dekhne ko mila hai. chunav aayog ki kathit 'vot chori' aur matdata suchi punrikshan (SIR) men dhandhli ke khilaph tejasvi yadav ne kendr sarkar par sidha hamla bola. tejasvi ne hunkar bharte hue kaha— "loktantr aur desh ke sanvidhan se khilvar kisi bhi kimat par bardasht nahin kiya jaega." dekhie dilli se eksaklusiv vidiyo riporta.
